jobs.description:
As a welder, you are responsible for manual and semi-automatic welding of different parts. You work precisely and have an eye for quality, because your workmanship directly impacts the final product.

A typical day involves reading technical plans, preparing materials, and handling welding tasks according to given specifications. You assemble the welded components into a solid, durable end product. You work independently, but can also cooperate with other skilled workers when needed.

Are you handy, detail-oriented, and do you take pride in a perfectly finished product? Then this job is for you. Apply now and show your skills!

• You have a technical background or proven welding experience.

• You can read and accurately follow technical plans.

• You are physically fit and enjoy hands-on work.

• You like working independently and pay attention to detail.

• You speak, write, and understand English.

As an operator, you work with the team to produce and process corrugated cardboard. You set up the machines, monitor the process, and check the quality. You solve small malfunctions yourself; for bigger issues, you can turn to the team leader. You work in an orderly, accurate, and independent way. Apply quickly if you like working in 2 shifts!

You speak fluent Dutch and/or English
You enjoy working independently and can operate a machine
You are accurate, tidy, and have an eye for detail
You are a true team player and eager to learn
You have a technical interest or experience (plus)
You have a diploma in lower or higher secondary education (BSO, TSO)
Experience is not required but is a plus
You have a correct and hardworking attitude

jobs.occupation: Orderpicker – Night Shift | Earn €20.85 per hour! – Become an essential link at SKF
jobs.description:
Are you ready to work night shifts and do you already have some experience as an order picker? Then this is your chance!

SKF, specialized in bearings, seals and lubrication systems, is the place where you contribute to keeping the world running smoothly daily. We are looking for motivated warehouse workers who provide top-quality service to our customers.

What will you do?
? Collect and prepare orders like a true professional
? Work with a high order-picking truck (no fear of heights!)
? Grow step by step thanks to internal training

Your work schedule:
Fixed night shift: Monday evening 22:00 – Saturday morning 06:00 Full-time or part-time. For part-time: Minimum 3 days per week. Option: 5 half days.

?? A high school diploma and initial experience as an orderpicker
?? No fear of heights and good physical condition
?? Strong comprehension and speaking level of either Dutch or English
?? Strong numerical skills, attention to detail and spatial awareness

As a Welder, you are responsible for welding aluminum profiles with quality and precision. You make sure every profile is processed according to the agreed guidelines, playing an important role in the production of design lighting fixtures.

A typical day includes operating the welding robot or TIG welding machine, preparing and cutting profiles, and setting the rolling machine. Together with your colleagues, you follow up on the order lists to ensure everything is completed accurately and on time. You work with great attention to detail and strive for a neat end result each time.

Are you passionate about technology and enjoy working with your hands? Do you want to be part of a team where you help create unique products? Apply quickly and discover this opportunity!

• Technical background
• Training in metalwork is a plus
• Experience as a welder (aluminum)
• You work accurately and pay attention to detail
• Good knowledge of Dutch or English

As a maintenance mechanic for trucks, you are responsible for the technical maintenance of trailers. You make sure that everything is ready for inspection and carry out interventions where needed. You replace brakes, shock absorbers and other worn parts. Welding work on trailers is also part of your job.

On a typical day, you start by checking trailers scheduled for inspection. You perform planned maintenance and repair defective parts. You assemble and disassemble components, work independently on repairs and coordinate with colleagues when necessary. If you have knowledge of hydraulics or electricity, that's a plus, but not a must. Communication with colleagues and, if needed, customers is in Dutch, French, English or German.

Do you like to get hands-on and make sure everything is in top technical condition? Are you solution-oriented and prefer to work independently? Apply now and take the first step toward this job!

• You have a diploma of lower secondary education or equivalent by experience

• You have at least 1 year of experience as a mechanic

• You can work independently and think in terms of solutions

• You have strong communication skills

• You have a good command of at least one of these languages: Dutch, French, English or German

• Basic knowledge of hydraulics or electricity is a plus, not a requirement

As an operator, together with a colleague, you are responsible for operating and setting up the production line. You use an overhead crane, set the correct parameters and knife distances, and make sure the rolls are properly packaged. Some administrative work on the computer is also part of your job. You work in two fixed shifts: from 5 a.m. to 1 p.m. or from 1 p.m. to 9 p.m.
Every day is varied: setting up machines, performing quality checks, and processing production documentation. You are alert to safety and contribute to a smooth production process.
Does this job appeal to you? Apply now!

• Relevant experience as an operator

• Technical insight and logical thinking

• Good computer skills

• Attention to quality and safety

• Stress-resistant and result-oriented

• Team player

• You speak fluent Dutch or English

As a Truck Driver CE, you are responsible for transporting goods within Belgium, Northern France, and Southern Netherlands. You load and unload the truck yourself with an electric pallet truck and always check your documents and vehicle. You register everything correctly in the onboard computer. Ready to hit the road independently? Apply now!

• You have a CE driving license and a valid professional competence certificate (code 95).

• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Truck Driver CE.

• You speak fluent Dutch or English.

• You can work independently and are accurate with administration.

• You are comfortable with a PC and onboard computer.

• You are willing to work an average of 12 hours per day.

• You live within commuting distance to Hooglede.

jobs.occupation: Operations Coordinator - Dutch & German speaking m/f/d (Callcenteragent/in)
jobs.description:
**Location:**  Ghent

Client confidential

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 

This is us, your new colleagues

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.

This is the job

- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.
- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.
- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.
- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?

- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.
- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.
- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.
- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.
- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.
- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.
- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.

A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...

- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.
- Well-being services
- Restaurant on site
- Opportunity to grow within the company
- Good work life balance
- International environment
- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

jobs.occupation: Become a Bodywork Assembler for an Innovative Body Shop Department in Rumst
jobs.description:
As a Bodywork Assembler, you are responsible for disassembling and assembling vehicles as part of body repairs. You will work daily on both traditional and electric vehicles, paying extra attention to safety and precision, especially with electric systems. You follow established procedures and collaborate with colleagues to deliver the best results for every customer.

On a typical workday, you'll start by reviewing the scheduled repairs. You remove and install parts like bumpers, lighting, and other bodywork components. You regularly work on electric vehicles, strictly following the safety guidelines for high voltage and battery systems. Close collaboration with painters and panel beaters is essential to ensure smooth workflow and top quality. After assembly, you conduct thorough quality control.

Can you see yourself working in an innovative environment with the latest technologies and infrastructure? Apply now and join a team that values quality, innovation, and teamwork.

• At least 1 to 2 years of experience as a bodywork assembler, disassembler, or technician in a body shop environment

• Knowledge of electric vehicles, including batteries and high-voltage components

• Able to work accurately, structured, and independently

• Good command of spoken and written English

• Holder of a valid category B driver's license

• Diploma of higher secondary education or equivalent through experience

Are you ready to take your career in offset printing to the next level? We are seeking a skilled Offset Printer to ensure our high-quality standards are met in every print run. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a team that values precision, efficiency, and teamwork.

In this role, your day will start by setting up and operating our state-of-the-art offset printing machines. You will be responsible for maintaining the printers, ensuring consistent quality, and troubleshooting any issues that arise during the production process. Collaboration is key as you'll work alongside other professionals to meet production goals and deadlines.

If you're passionate about printing and looking for a role where your contributions are valued, apply now! Join us and become an integral part of a workplace that offers growth and learning opportunities.

• At least 2-3 years of experience as an offset printer
• Technical qualifications in printing at A2/A3 level or equivalent experience
• Experience in multi-color offset printing; experience in printing on solid board or CBA is an additional advantage
• Team player with strong communication skills and the ability to maintain a collaborative work environment
• Attention to detail with an excellent sense of quality and safety
• Communicative knowledge of English or Dutch

Are you a night owl with a talent for solving technical challenges?

Do you thrive in a modern production environment where teamwork and quality are top priorities? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Your role

As a Maintenance Technician in the fixed night shift, you are essential to our production process. You ensure that machines operate at their best, perform preventive maintenance, and resolve malfunctions quickly and effectively. With your technical skills and problem-solving mindset, you keep the production running even while the world sleeps.

What will you do?

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.
• Detect, analyze, and fix malfunctions (primarily electrical, ideally with mechanical expertise).
• Start up and optimize production lines.
• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.
• Collaborate with a team and report to the technical service manager.
Work schedule

• 2 workdays (2 x 7.36 hours) and 2 weekend days (2 x 11 hours), offering a steady yet varied schedule.
 

 

• A technical degree or relevant experience in a production environment.
• Broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics; PLC knowledge is a plus.
• A flexible, positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.
• A team player who is eager to learn and improve.
• Fluency in Dutch or English.

What will you do?

What does your day look like as a truck driver with a Moffett?

  • You start early in the morning (between 5 AM and 6 AM) from our base in Deinze. Loading is not necessary – your truck is already prepared the night before. You follow a fixed route for a regular customer. On average, you make 4 to 6 deliveries per day across the Benelux.
  • You are responsible for unloading the goods yourself using the Moffett forklift attached to your truck. Our dispatch team is always ready to support you in case of questions, delays, or unexpected situations.
  • Finished with your deliveries? Then you drive back to Deinze – job done!

Interested?
Send your CV to Eeklo@absolutejobs.be

What do we expect from you?

  • You're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get things done
  • Physical work is part of the job for you – not an obstacle
  • You have your own transportation, as the truck stays on our premises
  • You can communicate fluently in Dutch, French, or English
  • You're a team player who’s ready to help out where needed
  • You keep your truck and trailer clean and tidy
  • You maintain clear communication with dispatch and other departments

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

Our client is a leading player in the events industry, specialising in the design and manufacture of exhibition stand systems. The company is renowned for its innovative approach and high-quality products, which are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions and events.

Let's Work is recruiting a production technician to work two shifts for an international market leader in Roeselare.

As a Production Technician, you will provide technical support within an automated production environment, with a 50/50 split between mechanical and electrical work. You will troubleshoot, analyse and resolve technical faults on a varied range of machinery, including CNC machines, robots, milling and sawing machines, while also carrying out preventive maintenance and implementing improvements together with the Technical Manager. You'll receive an attractive salary supplemented by meal vouchers, as well as thorough training and ongoing support in a modern working environment where safety, wellbeing and teamwork are key.

Do you get a kick out of tackling technical faults quickly and do you enjoy working with a varied and automated range of machinery? Then be sure to read on!

What will your tasks involve?

 
• 
You will identify, analyse and pragmatically resolve technical faults in the machinery so that production can resume quickly

 
• 
Following technical interventions, you document the work carried out and the solutions implemented

 
• 
You carry out preventive maintenance in accordance with the existing maintenance plan

 
• 
Together with the Technical Manager, you'll develop ideas for improvements and ensure their practical implementation

 
• 
Within the machinery fleet, you'll work with CNC machines, milling and sawing machines, handling and pick & place robots, and welding robots

 
• 
When technical problems arise, you take independent responsibility and actively seek a workable solution

 
• 
A technical qualification with prior experience in electromechanics forms the basis for this role

 
• 
Experience within an industrial production environment is important, preferably with CNC, robots, fully automated production lines and machine maintenance

 
• 
Knowledge of motors and gearboxes, compressed air, hydraulics, electricity and HMI is very useful

 
• 
Experience with welding is essential; a VCA certificate and a forklift or aerial work platform licence are an advantage

 
• 
Fluency in English is important for internal communication on the shop floor. You should also be comfortable using basic PC applications

 
• 
You are hands-on, independent, keen to learn and results-oriented and attach great importance to 5S and the safe handling of valuable equipment

Responsibilities

In this role as a Python ERP Developer, you take charge of the continuous evolution of internal business applications.

• Develop and refine custom features within the Odoo platform to streamline core operational processes.
• Connect software tools using clean API integrations and database structures to ensure accurate reporting.
• Troubleshoot technical issues quickly to maintain smooth daily workflows or coordinate with external development partners.
• Translate feedback from users in the field into clear technical specifications and practical solutions.
• Manage the internal reporting platform to guarantee overall system integration and data integrity.

 

     
Profile

For the position of Python ERP Developer, we are looking for a developer with a few years under their belt who combines analytical thinking with clear communication skills.

• Proven proficiency in Python and familiarity with other programming languages like .NET (ideally 2 to 4 years of experience in a similar role).
• Demonstrable experience with Odoo or a comparable ERP package is a major advantage.
• Colleagues describe you as a pragmatic problem solver who easily explains complex tech concepts to non-technical users.
• You speak English or French fluently, with at least a practical working knowledge of Dutch (or a strong willingness to learn).

For our client located in Ostend, we are looking for a High Voltage Technician. This company specializes in large, high-quality projects in West and East Flanders.

You job as a HIGH VOLTAGE ELECTRICIAN in OOSTENDE:

  • Maintenance and repair of high-voltage installations;
  • Identifying and resolving malfunctions;
  • Correct administrative processing of interventions;
  • Performing inspections and troubleshooting;
  • Testing and commissioning electrical systems;
  • Collaborating with engineers and project teams for innovative solutions.
Our client in Ostend is looking for a new High Voltage Technician with the following qualities:

  • Technical background with experience in medium/high-voltage installations or a strong interest in the field;
  • BA5 certification and strong awareness of safety regulations;
  • You speak DUTCH or GOOD ENGLISH;
  • Eager to learn and motivated to grow into an independent role.

For our client located in WESTENDE we are looking for a ROAD WORKER!

Our client is a well-known contractor who does assignments for the government and private sector.

Do you like to roll up your sleeves and work outdoors? Then you are the person we are looking for!

As a ROAD WORKER in WESTENDE this is your job:

  • You are responsible for sewerage works;
  • You are responsible for placing embroidery;
  • Construction of cycle paths, roads and car parks;
  • Placing environmental pavements;
  • Placing roundabouts and refuges;
  • Placing vowels and paving stones;

As a ROAD WORKER in WESTENDE you can find yourself in the following

  • You speak Englisch or Dutch
  • You are handy and like to work outside
  • No study requirements - motivation is what we need!

For our client, a well-known company in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER.

Do you enjoy variety in your job and love renovating? We've got you covered!

Your day as a RENOVATION WORKER in the Veurne region will look like this:

  • Together with your colleagues, you carry out demolition work;
  • You lay ceramic and natural stone tiles;
  • You ensure that masonry and cementing work is carried out correctly;

  • You ensure that the entire renovation is completed with high quality.



As a RENOVATION WORKER in VEURNE, you meet the following requirements:
